title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Free First Bank Transfer Allowance
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — the no-fee first bank transfer of a pay period.**

The first next-business-day bank transfer of a pay period is the only transfer to a bank account carrying its pay date. The free-transfer allowance limits that no-fee first bank transfer by the other transfers already carrying that pay date, whatever their speed or destination:

- when four or more stand, the first bank transfer carries the fee like any other;
- when two or three stand, it carries no fee only when its amount is 100.00 or less;
- otherwise it carries no fee.

A transfer that is not the first bank transfer of its pay period carries the fee.

| First bank transfer of the period | Other transfers carrying the pay date | Amount | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 0 or 1 | any | none |
| yes | 2 or 3 | 100.00 USD or less | none |
| yes | 2 or 3 | 100.01 USD or more | charged |
| yes | 4 or more | any | charged |
| no | any | any | charged |

*Hypothetical:* a worker's first bank transfer of the period, of 100.00 USD, follows three instant transfers carrying the same pay date: it carries no fee; at 100.01 USD it would carry the fee; after four instant transfers it carries the fee at either amount.
